documented_meaning: Month and year in which the loan was approved (Zenodo).
available_at_or_before_lending_decision_: Documentation defines issue_d as the approval month/year. That is the decision/origination stamp, not a pre-decision application timestamp, and not a post-decision servicing date. Flagged for methodology review if used as a model feature.
parsed_as: pandas datetime using format %b-%Y, with a secondary infer parse for leftovers
note: Train/validation/test cutoffs are not defined in Stage 2.
